info.name: NexPlay
info.description:
NexPlay API - Complete Collection. Covers Authentication, Company Management, Admin Dashboard, Match Center, Streaming Platforms, Favorites & Notifications, Ratings & Reviews, Discussion Forum, Gamification, and Moderation.

## Getting Started
1. Run all 4 seed scripts: `npm run seed && npm run seed:content && npm run seed:badges && npm run seed:new`
2. Start the server: `npm run dev`
3. Run the auth endpoints in order (Login User, Login Company, Login Admin) to set tokens
4. Variables are auto-set via test scripts - no manual copying needed
